samplePanels.focal: The silhouette of the Teacher standing beside gentle morning surf.

samplePanels.caption: The pull!
samplePanels.dialogue: Andrew: 'Simon, hold fast! The nets are breaking with fish!'
samplePanels.focal: Action panel: shimmering silver tilapia leaping as the ropes strain under abundance.

samplePanels.caption: On the shore.
samplePanels.dialogue: Jesus: 'Follow me, and I will make you fishers of men.'
samplePanels.focal: Warm close-up of Jesus extending a welcoming hand to the awe-struck brothers.

comics.title: Daniel & the Whispering Lions: A Graphic Devotional
comics.issue: Full Chapter Spread: The Den of Babylon
comics.style: Dramatic chiaroscuro watercolor panel layout with soft amber starlight and deep stone shadows
comics.logline: Cast into the pit of hungry beasts, Daniel's steadfast prayer invites an angel of peace into the den.

samplePanels.caption: The heavy stone seals the den.
samplePanels.dialogue: King Darius: 'May your God, whom you serve continually, rescue you!'
samplePanels.focal: Top panel showing the great stone sealing shut the pit opening above.

samplePanels.caption: In the darkness.
samplePanels.dialogue: Daniel: 'Lord, into Thy hands I commit my spirit.'
samplePanels.focal: Daniel kneeling quietly on the stone floor with eyes closed in prayer.

samplePanels.caption: A celestial glow.
samplePanels.dialogue: Angel: 'Peace be unto you, Daniel. God has shut the lions' mouths.'
samplePanels.focal: A radiant white angel gently resting hands upon the manes of two great lions who purr like kittens.

samplePanels.caption: The dawn brings joy.
samplePanels.dialogue: Daniel: 'O king, live forever! My God sent His angel and preserved me.'
samplePanels.focal: Morning light spilling down as the king peers joyfully into the unharmed den.

comics.title: The Good Samaritan: Highway to Jericho
comics.style: Sequential panels with warm desert earth tones and expressive emotional gestures
comics.logline: A traveler is passed by those who should have helped, until an unlikely neighbor stops to bind his wounds with oil and wine.

samplePanels.caption: The rocky road to Jericho.
samplePanels.dialogue: Narrator: 'A certain traveler was robbed and left wounded by the roadside.'
samplePanels.focal: Desolate desert highway with the traveler lying in the shadow of boulders.

samplePanels.caption: Passed by.
samplePanels.dialogue: Priest: 'I am too busy with temple duties to stop here today...'
samplePanels.focal: Split panel showing respectable figures hurrying past on the other side.

samplePanels.caption: The neighbor arrives.
samplePanels.dialogue: Samaritan: 'Hold on, brother. I have bandages, clean water, and oil for your wounds.'
samplePanels.focal: Compassionate stranger kneeling and pouring soothing oil onto bruised hands.

samplePanels.caption: At the inn.
samplePanels.dialogue: Samaritan: 'Take good care of him. Whatever more you spend, I will repay you when I return.'
samplePanels.focal: Innkeeper receiving silver coins while the injured traveler rests safely in bed.

comics.title: Barnaby & Pip: Night Investigators
comics.issue: Issue #1: The Case of the Missing Moonbeam
comics.style: Cozy nighttime comic panels with dark violet borders, speech balloons with playful animal font
comics.logline: Barnaby the Owl and Pip the Dormouse investigate why the attic moonbeam vanished, discovering a sleepy curtain flutter.

samplePanels.caption: Midnight in the library rafters.
samplePanels.dialogue: Pip: 'Barnaby! Emergency! The silver moonbeam on page 42 is completely gone!'
samplePanels.focal: Tiny mouse with a magnifying glass waving urgently to an owl with nightcap.

samplePanels.caption: Examining the clues.
samplePanels.dialogue: Barnaby: 'Hoo-dini! Notice the trajectory of the dust motes, Watson... er, Pip.'
samplePanels.focal: Barnaby inspecting a patch of shadow on an open book.

samplePanels.caption: The culprit revealed.
samplePanels.dialogue: Pip: 'Aha! Fluffy the cat was sleeping right on top of the velvet window drape!'
samplePanels.focal: Chubby orange tabby curled up on the heavy drape, blocking the moon.

samplePanels.caption: Case closed.
samplePanels.dialogue: Barnaby: 'Case solved, Pip. Time for chamomile tea and slumber.'
samplePanels.focal: Barnaby and Pip sipping steaming mugs as the moonbeam illuminates their cozy nook.

comics.title: The Pillow Fort Explorers
comics.issue: Chapter 1: Charting the Living Room Sea
comics.style: Vibrant watercolor panels with blueprint diagrams and imaginative thought bubbles
comics.logline: Armed with couch cushions, broom masts, and flashlight lanterns, two brothers navigate the living room carpet ocean.

samplePanels.caption: Fort construction complete.
samplePanels.dialogue: Leo: 'Cushion Bastion is secure. Hoist the flannel blanket flag!'
samplePanels.focal: Towering fort of floral sofa cushions held together with oversized clothespins.

samplePanels.caption: The floor is lava!
samplePanels.dialogue: Sam: 'Steer clear of the Persian rug strait! The carpet sharks are circling!'
samplePanels.focal: Imagination transition: floor turns into turquoise waves with friendly toy sharks.

samplePanels.caption: Flashlight beam.
samplePanels.dialogue: Leo: 'Lookout ahead! Lighthouse spotted on the Coffee Table Reef!'
samplePanels.focal: Flashlight beam illuminating a glowing salt lamp on the coffee table.

samplePanels.caption: Bedtime call.
samplePanels.dialogue: Mom (off-panel): 'All sailors report to berth for storybook hour!'
samplePanels.focal: Boys laughing and tucking under quilts inside the cozy cushion cabin.

comics.title: Star Hopper: A Little Astronaut’s Bedtime Comic
comics.style: Sleek retro-futuristic watercolor comic panels with glowing planetary rings and starlight dust
comics.logline: Young Commander Nora captains her cardboard rocket into the cosmic slumber sector to refuel sleepy constellations.

samplePanels.caption: Countdown to bedtime: T-minus 5 minutes.
samplePanels.dialogue: Nora: 'Ground control, Star Hopper engines engaged. Pajamas zipped.'
samplePanels.focal: Girl in cardboard helmet sitting inside rocket box in her bedroom.

samplePanels.caption: Orbit achieved.
samplePanels.dialogue: Computer: 'Welcome to Nebula Pillow 9. Gravity set to zero.'
samplePanels.focal: Bed floating among glowing watercolor planets and candy-cane asteroids.

samplePanels.caption: The Sleepy Comet.
samplePanels.dialogue: Nora: 'Approaching Comet Lullaby. Dispensing stardust sprinkles.'
samplePanels.focal: Shimmering golden comet smiling gently as the ship passes alongside.

samplePanels.caption: Landing in Dreamland.
samplePanels.dialogue: Nora: 'Mission accomplished. Initiating sleep mode.'
samplePanels.focal: Nora fast asleep under star-patterned duvet with helmet resting on nightstand.

comics.title: Campfire Tails: Woodland Animal Adventures
comics.style: Earthy watercolor palette with warm firelight glows, charming expressive animal characters
comics.logline: Cubby the Bear, Bramble the Hedgehog, and Hazel the Squirrel tell bedtime ghost stories around a glowing acorn fire.

samplePanels.caption: Around the warm embers.
samplePanels.dialogue: Hazel: 'And they say the Great Pine Monster was ten acorns tall!'
samplePanels.focal: Squirrel with wide eyes gesturing dramatically beside flickering twig fire.

samplePanels.caption: A rustle in the ferns.
samplePanels.dialogue: Bramble: 'Eep! What was that rustling sound in the blackberry bush?!'
samplePanels.focal: Hedgehog curling into a frightened ball with quills poking up.

samplePanels.caption: A friendly face.
samplePanels.dialogue: Cubby: 'Relax, Bramble! It's just Old Badger bringing toasted marshmallows!'
samplePanels.focal: Gentle grandfather badger emerging with roasted pine-sap treats on twigs.

samplePanels.caption: Cozy ending.
samplePanels.dialogue: All: 'Yum! Best campout in the Whispering Woods!'
samplePanels.focal: All four animals curled together under a cedar bough fast asleep.

comics.title: The Boy Who Built a Rocket to Dreamland
comics.style: Sequential spreads with blueprint architectural sketches and painterly watercolor backgrounds
comics.logline: Tired of regular dreams, Toby constructs a wooden flyer powered by clockwork springs and bedtime lullabies.

samplePanels.caption: The attic workshop.
samplePanels.dialogue: Toby: 'Just one more gear on the dream-compass... and presto!'
samplePanels.focal: Boy tightening a brass bolt on a whimsical winged flying machine.

samplePanels.caption: Launching through the skylight.
samplePanels.dialogue: Toby: 'Hang on, Astro Dog! Next stop: The Cloud Carousel!'
samplePanels.focal: Machine swooping through open roof window into starry lavender sky.

samplePanels.caption: Among the clouds.
samplePanels.dialogue: Astro Dog: 'Woof!' (Translation: Look at those cotton-candy clouds!)
samplePanels.focal: Puppy with goggles sticking head out of cockpit catching cloud mist.

samplePanels.caption: Landing safely.
samplePanels.dialogue: Toby: 'Nothing beats sleeping in your own bed after a trip to the stars.'
samplePanels.focal: Toby tucked under blankets with model rocket perched on dresser.

comics.title: Otter & Owl: Midnight Creek Detectives
comics.style: Lush aquatic watercolor panels with cool blues, teals, and luminous insect gold
comics.logline: Why did the creek path go dark? Oliver the Otter swims upstream to find a beaver who borrowed the fireflies for night reading.

samplePanels.caption: The dark creek crossing.
samplePanels.dialogue: Oliver: 'Hoo-boy, Barnaby! The stepping stones are pitch dark tonight!'
samplePanels.focal: Otter poking head above dark water looking at unlit reeds.

samplePanels.caption: Tracking the glow.
samplePanels.dialogue: Barnaby: 'Follow that faint emerald light behind the willow dam!'
samplePanels.focal: Owl pointing wing toward a cozy glow filtering through birch logs.

samplePanels.caption: The secret reader.
samplePanels.dialogue: Beaver: 'I'm sorry! I just had two chapters left of my bedtime mystery!'
samplePanels.focal: Beaver sitting in lodge with a glass jar of fireflies illuminating an open book.

samplePanels.caption: Shared storytime.
samplePanels.dialogue: Oliver: 'Well, scoot over! Start from chapter one!'
samplePanels.focal: All three animals listening peacefully to the story together under the soft glow.

comics.title: The Pajama Knights: Guardians of the Nursery
comics.style: Playful comic panels with cozy flannel textures, wooden swords, and warm golden nightlights
comics.logline: When nighttime floorboards go 'creak!', Sir Arthur and Lady Claire don their slippers to prove shadows are just friendly coats on pegs.

samplePanels.caption: The nursery is dark. CREAK!
samplePanels.dialogue: Arthur: 'Hark! The dreaded Floorboard Ogre awakens!'
samplePanels.focal: Two kids in striped pajamas raising wooden spoon swords in alarm.

samplePanels.caption: Approaching the closet.
samplePanels.dialogue: Claire: 'Hold the Nightlight of Bravery steady, Arthur!'
samplePanels.focal: Beam from turtle-shaped nightlight cutting through bedroom shadows.

samplePanels.caption: The grand reveal.
samplePanels.dialogue: Arthur: 'Behold! The monster is... Dad's winter bathrobe hanging on a hook!'
samplePanels.focal: Hilarious panel showing fluffy plaid robe casting a dragon-shaped shadow.

samplePanels.caption: Victory sleep.
samplePanels.dialogue: Claire: 'Another kingdom saved. Goodnight, brave knight.'
samplePanels.focal: Both kids fast asleep under patchwork shields with peaceful smiles.

comics.title: Cloud Patrol: The Flying Puppy Chronicles
comics.style: Soft pastel watercolor panels with whimsical balloon lettering and cute puppy anatomy
comics.logline: Barnaby the golden pup sprouts angel wings at bedtime to help shepherd stray clouds away from the moon.

samplePanels.caption: Cloud Patrol HQ.
samplePanels.dialogue: Barnaby: 'Fluffy cloud cluster approaching the moon at 9 o'clock!'
samplePanels.focal: Golden retriever puppy with small feathered wings hovering above clouds.

samplePanels.caption: Nudging the cloud.
samplePanels.dialogue: Barnaby: 'Woof! Move along, puffy cloud! The stars need to shine!'
samplePanels.focal: Puppy gently nudging a sleepy cloud with his wet black nose.

samplePanels.caption: The moon thanks him.
samplePanels.dialogue: Moon: 'Thank you, little patrol pup. Here is a bone made of moonbeams.'
samplePanels.focal: Smiling moon handing glowing golden biscuit to the happy puppy.

samplePanels.caption: Back in the dog bed.
samplePanels.dialogue: Barnaby: 'Zzz... best job in the world... zzz...'
samplePanels.focal: Puppy sleeping in cozy wicker basket with back leg gently twitching in a dream.

comics.title: Bramble the Hedgehog's Big Night Walk
comics.style: Gentle sequential comic for beginning readers, limited palette of moss, acorn brown, and starlight amber
comics.logline: A little hedgehog takes his nightly stroll through garden beds, greeting snails, smelling sweet honeysuckle, and finding his mossy burrow.

samplePanels.caption: Sun goes down. Time to wake up!
samplePanels.dialogue: Bramble: 'Good evening, world!'
samplePanels.focal: Tiny hedgehog uncurling from dry leaves, nose sniffing fresh evening air.

samplePanels.caption: Saying hello to friends.
samplePanels.dialogue: Bramble: 'Hello, Mr. Snail! Nice shell tonight!'
samplePanels.focal: Bramble smiling at a glossy snail gliding across a moist garden stone.

samplePanels.caption: Sweet bedtime snack.
samplePanels.dialogue: Bramble: 'Ripe wild strawberries! My favorite!'
samplePanels.focal: Bramble happily nibbling a bright red berry under clover leaves.

samplePanels.caption: Curling up for sleep.
samplePanels.dialogue: Bramble: 'The moon is high. Time for little hedgehogs to rest.'
samplePanels.focal: Cute round hedgehog ball nestled safe inside hollow oak root.

comics.title: The Blanket Map: Quest for the Golden Pillow
comics.style: Detailed map border illustration with central storytelling panel sequences and hand-drawn compass
comics.logline: A bedtime quest through the archipelago of Sleepy Islands, guided by the legendary quilted map.

samplePanels.caption: Unfolding the quilted heirloom.
samplePanels.dialogue: Captain Theo: 'According to this quilt, the Golden Pillow lies beyond Yawn Canyon.'
samplePanels.focal: Boy examining patchwork quilt with stitched islands and embroidered sea monsters.

samplePanels.caption: Crossing Yawn Canyon.
samplePanels.dialogue: Theo: '*YAAAWN*... Keep paddling, first mate Bear!'
samplePanels.focal: Boy and stuffed bear yawning widely as their wooden slipper boat drifts through purple gorge.

samplePanels.caption: The Island of Feather Down.
samplePanels.dialogue: Theo: 'We found it! The softest resting place in all seven seas!'
samplePanels.focal: A glowing golden silk pillow resting on a pedestal of cloud puffs.

samplePanels.caption: Slumber achieves.
samplePanels.dialogue: Narrator: 'And so the captain dropped anchor in peaceful sleep.'
samplePanels.focal: Theo head resting on pillow with arm wrapped around bear, breathing deeply.

comics.title: The Clockwork Apprentice & the Brass Fox
comics.style: Detailed steampunk fairytale watercolor panels with hand-drawn gears and warm sepia inks
comics.logline: Young apprentice Felix accidentally breathes life into an intricate brass fox automaton using a fallen meteorite spring.

samplePanels.caption: The clocktower workshop.
samplePanels.dialogue: Felix: 'If this escapement wheel fits the escapement lever...'
samplePanels.focal: Felix holding tweezers carefully inserting a glowing bronze gear into a metal fox chest.

samplePanels.caption: CLICK! WHIRRR!
samplePanels.dialogue: Fox: '*YAP!* (Cogs spin with golden sparks)'
samplePanels.focal: Mechanical fox eyes ignite with warm emerald glass glow; brass tail swishes.

samplePanels.caption: The chase!
samplePanels.dialogue: Felix: 'Wait! Don't jump out the cathedral clockface!'
samplePanels.focal: Dynamic action panel: brass fox leaping across wooden clocktower beams with Felix in pursuit.

samplePanels.caption: A new bond.
samplePanels.dialogue: Felix: 'You're not just gears, are you? You have a heart of your own.'
samplePanels.focal: Fox nuzzling Felix's outstretched hand with gentle gear hum.

comics.title: Dragon Whisperers of the Mist Valley
comics.issue: Chapter 1: The Hatchling in the Moss
comics.style: Lush epic fantasy panels with sweeping watercolor landscape vistas and expressive creature designs
comics.logline: A mountain shepherd girl discovers an orphaned cloud-drake egg hatching among blue alpine moss.

samplePanels.caption: High above the tree line.
samplePanels.dialogue: Kira: 'That's no ordinary geode... It's warm to the touch!'
samplePanels.focal: Kira kneeling beside an iridescent sapphire egg resting in blue alpine lichen.

samplePanels.caption: CRACK!
samplePanels.dialogue: Kira: 'It's hatching! Gently now...'
samplePanels.focal: Close-up on egg shell breaking open to reveal tiny horned snout and sneezing smoke.

samplePanels.caption: First flight.
samplePanels.dialogue: Hatchling: '*CHIRP!*' (Flaps tiny winglets and hovers two inches high)
samplePanels.focal: Adorable baby dragon hovering over Kira's palm with proud grin.

samplePanels.caption: The vow.
samplePanels.dialogue: Kira: 'I will protect you until your wings can touch the clouds.'
samplePanels.focal: Heroic silhouette panel of girl and baby dragon against setting alpine sun.

comics.title: The Sprite of Lantern Oak
comics.style: Luminous enchanted forest panels with jewel-toned watercolors and glowing fungal accents
comics.logline: When the great lantern that keeps the forest safe flickers dim, young sprite Pip must journey to the Sun Well.

samplePanels.caption: The Grandfather Oak is dimming.
samplePanels.dialogue: Elder Sprite: 'Without the lantern's spark, the Shadow Brambles will creep into our glade.'
samplePanels.focal: Ancient oak with flickering glass lantern hanging from central branch.

samplePanels.caption: Pip accepts the quest.
samplePanels.dialogue: Pip: 'I may be the smallest sprite, but my wings are fast!'
samplePanels.focal: Determined little boy sprite donning acorn helmet and strapping on dewdrops canteen.

samplePanels.caption: Over the mushroom gorge.
samplePanels.dialogue: Pip: 'Whoa! Hold on to your antennae!'
samplePanels.focal: Pip gliding on the back of a friendly monarch butterfly over glowing toadstool canyon.

samplePanels.caption: The Sun Well reached.
samplePanels.dialogue: Pip: 'Behold! The pure liquid starlight!'
samplePanels.focal: Pip dipping crystal vial into radiant pool of bubbling golden liquid.

comics.title: The Tiny Knight and the Thimble Sword
comics.issue: Issue 1: The Toad of Bramble Gate
comics.style: Charming macro fantasy comic panels showing mouse-scale adventures among roots, flowers, and pebbles
comics.logline: Sir Barnaby of the Acorn Guard defends the fairy queen's clover patch from an unruly garden toad.

samplePanels.caption: Inspection of the guard.
samplePanels.dialogue: Sir Barnaby: 'Armor polished, needle lance sharpened, walnut shield ready!'
samplePanels.focal: Tiny heroic mouse knight adjusting shiny silver sewing thimble helmet.

samplePanels.caption: A giant approaches!
samplePanels.dialogue: Guard: 'CROAAAK! Giant warty beast breaching the southern dandelion wall!'
samplePanels.focal: Enormous mottled garden toad looming over tiny clover gate.

samplePanels.caption: The clever tactic.
samplePanels.dialogue: Sir Barnaby: 'No weapons needed! Present the juiciest fat garden beetle!'
samplePanels.focal: Barnaby rolling a shiny sweet beetle on a leaf toward the toad.

samplePanels.caption: A peaceful truce.
samplePanels.dialogue: Toad: '*GULP!* (Friendly wink)'
samplePanels.focal: Toad happily munching beetle, letting the tiny knights pet his bumpy chin.

comics.title: Chronicles of the Silver Gryphon
comics.style: Sweeping cinematic panels with airy watercolor washes, ice crystals, and soaring flight perspectives
comics.logline: Cadet Rowan trains with his juvenile gryphon companion, learning that true leadership comes from trust, not reins.

samplePanels.caption: The Eyrie of Highreach.
samplePanels.dialogue: Rowan: 'Easy, Silverwing. The updraft over the glacier is strong today.'
samplePanels.focal: Boy gently stroking the silver feathers of a magnificent half-eagle, half-lion beast.

samplePanels.caption: Takeoff!
samplePanels.dialogue: Rowan: 'FOR THE REALM!'
samplePanels.focal: Dynamic downward camera angle as gryphon leaps from stone cliff into blinding white sky.

samplePanels.caption: Caught in the crosswind.
samplePanels.dialogue: Rowan: 'Drop the reins! Fly as one mind!'
samplePanels.focal: Rowan letting go of leather straps, hugging gryphon's neck as wings catch thermal current.

samplePanels.caption: Gliding through clouds.
samplePanels.dialogue: Rowan: 'We did it! We cleared the Frost Peak!'
samplePanels.focal: Breathtaking wide panel of gryphon soaring smoothly above cloud sea toward sunlit spires.

comics.title: The Alchemist’s Garden: Graphic Novel Series
comics.style: Botanical fantasy panels with hand-illustrated plant cross-sections, glowing vials, and warm cottage charm
comics.logline: Young botanist Clara tends to magical plants that produce honey-glow elixirs and whispering tea leaves.

samplePanels.caption: The greenhouse at midnight.
samplePanels.dialogue: Clara: 'Add three drops of dew from a morning bluebell...'
samplePanels.focal: Clara in leather apron carefully measuring glowing blue liquid into brass flask.

samplePanels.caption: The sprout blooms!
samplePanels.dialogue: Clara: 'It worked! The Sun-Orchid is opening!'
samplePanels.focal: Golden flower petals unfurl, emitting warm radiant light that illuminates the glass dome.

samplePanels.caption: A visitor at the window.
samplePanels.dialogue: Moon Fairy: 'The scent of your elixir reached the whispering woods, Clara.'
samplePanels.focal: Delicate winged fairy tapping on the condensation-covered glass pane.

samplePanels.caption: Sharing the harvest.
samplePanels.dialogue: Clara: 'A vial of warmth for the winter fairies. As promised.'
samplePanels.focal: Clara handing crystal bottle with glowing golden stopper to the grateful fairy.

comics.title: The Sea Sprite and the Coral Castle
comics.style: Rich aquatic fantasy panels with glowing bioluminescence, flowing seaweed kelp, and shell architecture
comics.logline: Tula the sea sprite helps rebuild the shattered reef palace after a wandering kraken sneezes.

samplePanels.caption: The Great Barrier Reef.
samplePanels.dialogue: Tula: 'Look at the western archway! The kraken's sneeze knocked over the pearl pillar!'
samplePanels.focal: Sprite with dolphin tail surveying tumbled coral columns under turquoise waves.

samplePanels.caption: Calling the builders.
samplePanels.dialogue: Tula: 'Hermit crabs, parrotfish! To your stations!'
samplePanels.focal: Tula blowing into a conch shell, summoning schools of helpful sea creatures.

samplePanels.caption: Rebuilding with magic.
samplePanels.dialogue: Crab Foreman: 'Mortar made of star-sponge is setting nicely, ma'am!'
samplePanels.focal: Busy humorous panel of crabs stacking mother-of-pearl tiles with crab claws.

samplePanels.caption: The palace restored.
samplePanels.dialogue: Sea Queen: 'The castle shines brighter than before! Thank you, little sprite.'
samplePanels.focal: Splendid illuminated coral palace glowing with pink, emerald, and gold sea anemones.

comics.title: The Wizard's Attic: Early Reader Fantasy Panels
comics.style: Fun comic panels for young readers with bright watercolor fills, comic sound FX, and slapstick charm
comics.logline: Archie the wizard's apprentice tries a simple feather-levitating charm, but his wand has allergies and turns everything into purple balloons.

samplePanels.caption: Wizard Barnaby is away.
samplePanels.dialogue: Archie: 'Just one teeny tiny spell while the master is buying elderberries...'
samplePanels.focal: Boy in oversized starry wizard hat pointing crooked wooden wand at a goose feather.

samplePanels.caption: A sudden tickle.
samplePanels.dialogue: Wand: '*AH-CHOO!* (Rainbow sparks erupt)'
samplePanels.focal: Huge comic explosion of colorful sparks and floating violet bubbles.

samplePanels.caption: Balloon invasion!
samplePanels.dialogue: Archie: 'The teacups are floating! The spellbooks are floating! THE CAT IS FLOATING!'
samplePanels.focal: Chaotic funny panel with wizard cat clinging to a floating spellbook balloon.

samplePanels.caption: The Master returns.
samplePanels.dialogue: Master Barnaby: 'Archie... why is my armchair on the ceiling?'
samplePanels.focal: Archie grinning sheepishly while hanging upside down from a velvet balloon chair.

comics.title: The Rune Carver's Daughter
comics.style: Nordic folk fantasy sequential art with stone textures, glowing runic glyphs, and pine needle borders
comics.logline: Ingrid discovers that the ancient stones her grandfather carved can speak when touched by the northern lights.

samplePanels.caption: The rune yard in winter.
samplePanels.dialogue: Ingrid: 'Grandfather's chisel has rested for forty winters...'
samplePanels.focal: Girl running her finger along weathered Nordic runes carved into granite monoliths.

samplePanels.caption: The sky ignites.
samplePanels.dialogue: Ingrid: 'Look! The aurora borealis is touching the ridge!'
samplePanels.focal: Vibrant ribbons of green and violet northern lights dancing in the starry night sky.

samplePanels.caption: The stone speaks.
samplePanels.dialogue: Stone Voice: 'The keeper has returned. What riddle do you seek, child of the North?'
samplePanels.focal: Runic glyphs glowing with warm cyan luminescence on the ancient stone face.

samplePanels.caption: The first secret.
samplePanels.dialogue: Ingrid: 'Tell me the forgotten story of how the sun learned to rise.'
samplePanels.focal: Ingrid sitting cross-legged in the snow listening in awe as the stone hums with light.

comics.title: The Clockwork Castle Siege

samplePanels.focal: Humorous action shot of beetles sliding harmlessly off polished gears into safety nets.

samplePanels.caption: Victory for the gears.

samplePanels.focal: Mechanical soldiers cheering with raised wrenches as steam whistles blow triumphantly.
